name: University of Tennessee
oos_note: Public university. Non-resident (out-of-state) undergraduate tuition & fees for 2024-25 = $33,256 per NCES College Navigator (official IPEDS data, id 221759); in-state listed as $13,812, consistent with the known in-state figure ($13,876). UTK OneStop tuition pages point to per-semester PDF rate tables rather than a single annual total.
